prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Chinese woman — the personification of Beijing — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Beijing as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Beijing with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the dressing room behind the stage of an old opera theatre kept two centuries on — racks of real embroidered opera robes with long white flowing sleeves, jewelled headdresses on their stands, pots of face paint and a smart mirror ringed with soft light.
Around her, as her world makes them: a whirring palm-sized electric fan; a bouquet of real fresh flowers in a clear wrap with a softly glowing band; pink and cyan neon tubes and light strips; a holographic phone screen projected from her wrist.
Season: spring — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: a low warm light source near her — a lamp, a fire or a screen — glowing on her from below shoulder height.
Outfit: a baker costume cut as a floor-length gown with a high side slit — a double-breasted baker's front and a short waist apron — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a silk ribbon tied in her hair, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the left of the frame; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a compact mirror open in front of her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a pen-thin mending tool of white ceramic tipped with a fine point of golden light — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
